blocks.heading: What is BT10?
blocks.body: Thymosin beta-4 fragment profile for cell-migration and tissue-repair research. Coze describes TB-500 as a synthetic peptide fragment corresponding to the active region of thymosin beta-4, a naturally occurring 43-amino-acid protein involved in tissue repair, regeneration, anti-inflammatory signaling, and wound-healing models. TB500 10mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU BT10. Current storefront values use our product data: 10mg x 10 vials /box, $135.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 5mg x 10 vials / 10mg x 10 vials.
